(from [[Grothmar Wardowns]]) }} [[Katye Bloodburner]] is a [[Charr]] [[boss]] who spawns in the Charr stronghold in northwestern [[Sacnoth Valley]]. He uses [[Elementalist]] spells in addition to [[Necromancer]] spells, and his [[AoE]] fire spells can be deadly to an unprepared team. ==Locations== *[[Charr Homelands]] **{{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}} ==Skills== *{{skill icon|Life Siphon}} *{{skill icon|Life Transfer}} ([[elite]]) *{{skill icon|Signet of Lost Souls}} *{{skill icon|Fire Storm}} *{{skill icon|Mark of Rodgort}} *{{skill icon|Meteor Shower}} ==Items dropped== *[[Charr Garment]] *[[Superb Charr Carving]] *[[The Bloodburner]] ([[unique]]) ==Notes== *You need to have done the [[Assault on the Stronghold]] [[mission]] before you will be able to reach him. *He will not spawn if you have the [[quest]] [[Forbidden Fruit]] active. ==Trivia== *Named after [[Katy Hargrove]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive_2&oldid=447273#Edielh_Shockhunter source]).
